visible: Single continuous dark annular body with round through opening; background grid visible through the opening.

not_established: Which bearing face is upper in installed stack; no mounting orientation certification from this exposure.
Reverse face, hidden cavity/step/undercut, total free thickness, internal sleeve or bonded insert.
